nodes.rationale: Errors for missing source_url/retrieved_at/raw file, article gaps not listed in known_gaps, empty or duplicate articles, broken chunk->article->version->document chain, unresolved citation_id, active edition without verified_by; non-zero exit on any error.

nodes.label: Legal ingestion pipeline (10 steps)
nodes.rationale: Each step writes JSONL to legal_data/processed/; re-running without changes changes nothing (idempotent).

nodes.rationale: Files are kept exactly as downloaded and never edited by hand; named <document_key>_<language>_<edition_date>.<ext>.

nodes.norm_label: segment step (segment.py: sections -> chapters -> articles -> parts)

nodes.label: Edition review workflow (pending_review -> active -> superseded)
nodes.rationale: A new edition loads as pending_review while verified_by is empty and is unused until a human activates it; on activation the previous edition gets effective_to; old editions are never deleted because scenarios with an earlier legal_date need them.

nodes.label: eval command (Recall@K on eval/gold.jsonl)
nodes.rationale: Recall@5 and Recall@10 for dense, sparse and hybrid search per language, reported in eval/report.md; used to pick the embedding model by hour 10, and the numbers go into the presentation.

nodes.label: legal_ingestion offline CLI (python -m legal_ingestion run)
nodes.rationale: An offline tool, not part of the API; run by hand or in CI. One command turns raw/ and sources.yaml into a ready database and a demo seed file.

nodes.label: No mass scraping of lex.uz
nodes.rationale: No open lex.uz API is confirmed and the brief forbids mass scraping without permission. Terms of use and robots.txt are checked first; fetch downloads only sources.yaml URLs one by one with a pause and a clear User-Agent, and is off (FETCH_ENABLED=false) unless allowed. Roadmap: an official data-access agreement with the lex.uz operator.

nodes.label: legal_data/seed.sql.gz (demo seed)
nodes.rationale: dump writes all legal tables with precomputed vectors; Postgres in docker compose loads it on first start via /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/, so the demo needs no download, no embedding computation and no API key. Rebuilt and committed after every corpus change.

nodes.rationale: If the best result is below RAG_MIN_SCORE, done is sent with insufficient_sources: true without calling the LLM.

nodes.label: Fact-grounded NPC answers
nodes.rationale: The fast LLM only classifies the question into an enum question_id and rephrases the engine's fact_ids, which are the source of truth; the prompt forbids new facts. Invalid output or a 4 s timeout falls back to a canned line. Key flags are set only through normal ask_<question_id> game actions, never from LLM output.

nodes.label: REST + SSE instead of WebSocket
nodes.rationale: The game is turn-based request/response; the server never pushes on its own (no multiplayer, no server timers). Only the AI mentor answer needs a stream, and one-way SSE over plain HTTP is simpler to proxy and debug. WebSocket may be added later, e.g. for a live teacher view; not in the MVP.
